input.command:
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3; python - <<'E'
import os,tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
c=load("examples/service.conf")
print(c.get("level",section="logging"),c.get("name"))
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
w=lambda n,t:open(os.path.join(d,n),"w").write(t)
w("a","@include b\n");w("b","@include a\n");w("m","@include nope\n");w("s","@include s\n")
os.makedirs(d+"/sub");open(d+"/sub/x","w").write("k=1\n@include y\n");open(d+"/sub/y","w").write("z=2\n")
w("n","k=0\n@include sub/x\nz=3\n")
for f in "a","m","s":
    try: load(os.path.join(d,f))
    except ConfigError as e: print("ok",e)
c=load(d+"/n");print(c.get("k"),c.get("z"))
E
